examples.text: tasmā have lokavidū sumedho, lok'antagū vusitabrahmacariyo, lokassa antaṃ samitāvi ñatvā, n'āsīsatī lokam'imaṃ parañ'cā'ti.
saññaṃ pariññā vitareyya oghaṃ, pariggahesu muni n'opalitto, abbūḷhasallo caram'appamatto, n'āsīsatī lokam'imaṃ parañ'cā'ti.

36573.grammar: masc, from na asūra, neg x2
36573.commentary: (SNa) n'āsūraṃ jātipaccayā'ti, ayaṃ jātisampanno'ti evaṃ jātikāraṇā asūraṃ na bhareyya. (JAa) n'āsūro'ti na asūro bhīrukajātiko.

examples.text: issattaṃ balavīriyañ'ca, yasmiṃ vijjetha māṇave, taṃ yuddh'attho bhare rājā, n'āsūraṃ jātipaccayā.
na hi rājakulaṃ patto, aññāto labhate yasaṃ, n'āsūro n'āpi dummedho, nappamatto kudācanaṃ.

36574.meaning2: should be killed, should be ruined, should be destroyed, should be expelled

examples.text: tass'eva kho pana, bhikkhave, mahato migasaṅghassa koci'd'eva puriso uppajjeyya atthakāmo hitakāmo yogakkhemakāmo. so yv'āssa maggo khemo sovatthiko pītigamanīyo taṃ maggaṃ vivareyya, pidaheyya kummaggaṃ, ūhaneyya okacaraṃ, nāseyya okacārikaṃ.

tass'eva kho pana, bhikkhave, mahato migasaṅghassa koci'd'eva puriso uppajjeyya atthakāmo hitakāmo yogakkhemakāmo. so yv'āssa maggo khemo sovatthiko pītigamanīyo taṃ maggaṃ vivareyya, pidaheyya kummaggaṃ, ūhaneyya okacaraṃ, nāseyya okacārikaṃ.

36577.meaning2: to cause to ruin; to cause to destroy

36578.meaning2: having killed, having ruined, having destroyed, having expelled

36582.grammar: opt of na atthi, irreg, neg, intrans (+nom)

examples.text: pāṇimhi ce vaṇo n'āssa, hareyya pāṇinā visaṃ, n'ābbaṇaṃ visam'anveti, n'atthi pāpaṃ akubbato.

pacchimāyaṃ, bhante, bhittiyan'ti. pacchimā ce, bhikkhave, bhitti n'āssa kv'āssa patiṭṭhitā'ti? pathaviyaṃ, bhante'ti. pathavī ce, bhikkhave, n'āssa kv'āssa patiṭṭhitā'ti? āpasmiṃ, bhante'ti. āpo ce, bhikkhave, n'āssa kv'āssa patiṭṭhitā'ti? appatiṭṭhitā, bhante'ti.

36583.meaning1: not to him; nor for him

examples.text: na brāhmaṇassa pahareyya, n'āssa muñcetha brāhmaṇo, dhī brāhmaṇassa hantāraṃ, tato dhī yassa muñcati.
tam'enaṃ samannesamāno evaṃ jānāti, ñatt'ajjhāpanno ayam'āyasmā bhikkhu yasappatto, n'āssa idh'ekacce ādīnavā saṃvijjantī'ti.
disvāna aññam'aññaṃ saṇṭhapesuṃ, ayaṃ kho, āvuso, samaṇo gotamo āgacchati bāhulliko padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāya. so n'eva abhivādetabbo, na paccuṭṭhātabbo, n'āssa pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ.

36585.meaning1: that would not be for him

examples.text: tam'enaṃ sāvakā evaṃ jānanti, ayaṃ kho bhavaṃ satthā aparisuddhasīlo samāno parisuddhasīlo'mhī'ti paṭijānāti parisuddhaṃ me sīlaṃ pariyodātaṃ asaṃkiliṭṭhan'ti. mayañ'c'eva kho pana gihīnaṃ āroceyyāma, n'āss'assa manāpaṃ.

36586.grammar: opt 3rd pl of na atthi, irreg conjugation, neg, intrans (+nom)
36586.meaning1: they would not be; there might not be

examples.text: siyā nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā imasmiñ'ca saviññāṇake kāye ahaṅ'kāra-mamaṅ'kāra-mān'ānusayā n'āssu

36587.meaning1: certainly did not in this case
36587.commentary: (SNa) n'āssudhā'ti ettha assudhā'ti padapūraṇamatte avadhāraṇatthe vā nipāto, n'eva koci bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamī'ti attho.

examples.text: evaṃ, bhante'ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā n'āssudha koci bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamati, aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakena.

36588.grammar: aor of na suṇāti, neg, trans (+acc)
36588.construction:
na + a + so + si
na + assosi

examples.text: santān'eva nu kho, bhante, sunakkhatto licchaviputto dibbāni saddāni n'āssosi piyarūpāni kām'ūpasaṃhitāni rajanīyāni, udāhu asantānī'ti?
hoti ca me anutāpo, aparaddhaṃ dukkhitañ'ca me bhante, s'āhaṃ dhammaṃ n'āssosiṃ, sudesitaṃ dhammarājena.

36589.grammar: pr, from na avakaṅkhati, neg, trans (+acc)
36589.meaning1: does not desire; does not wish (for)
36589.construction:
na + ava + kaṅkha + ti
na + avakaṅkhati
36589.notes: (MW) an-avakāṅkṣamāṇa, not wishing impatiently (said of ascetics who, having renounced all food, expect death without impatience), Jain.

examples.text: satthaṃ, āvuso sāriputta, āharissāmi, n'āvakaṅkhāmi jīvitan'ti.

36590.meaning1: does not disrespect (on); does not despise; does not have a low opinion (of)
36590.commentary: (UDa) n'āvajānāti sadevako'pi loko'ti sabbo sapaññajātiko sattaloko sadevako'pi sabrahmako'pi na kadāci'pi avajānāti na paribhoti, atha kho ayam'eva loke aggo seṭṭho uttamo pavaroti garuṃ karonto sakkaccaṃ pūjāsakkāranirato hotī'ti.

examples.text: yassa papañcā ṭhiti ca n'atthi, sandānaṃ palighañ'ca vītivatto, taṃ nittaṇhaṃ muniṃ carantaṃ, n'āvajānāti sadevako'pi loko'ti.

36591.grammar: opt of na avajānāti, irreg, neg, trans (+acc)
36591.meaning1: should not despise; should not disdain; should not look down (on)
36591.construction:
na + ava + jānā + iyā
na + avajāniyā

examples.text: sa pattapāṇi vicaranto, amūgo mūgasammato, appaṃ dānaṃ na hīḷeyya, dātāraṃ n'āvajāniyā.

36592.grammar: pr, pass of na avajināti, neg, intrans

na + ava + jīya + ti

nāvā nāma yāya tarati. nāvaṭṭhaṃ nāma bhaṇḍaṃ nāvāya nikkhittaṃ hoti.

36594.grammar: pr, from na avatiṭṭhati, neg, intrans (+loc)

36594.construction:

36594.commentary: (THa) yattha bhayaṃ n'āvatiṭṭhatī'ti yasmiṃ nibbāne yathāvuttaṃ bhayaṃ na tiṭṭhati okāsaṃ na labhati.

examples.text: na sūpahatacitto'mhi, n'āvattena suvānayo, na vo cir'āhaṃ kujjhāmi, kodho mayi n'āvatiṭṭhati.

36595.grammar: pr, from na avabujjhati, neg, trans (+acc)

na + avasādayati

36597.grammar: pr, from na avaharati, neg, trans (+acc)

36597.construction:
na + ava + hara + ti
na + avaharati

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, sāmuddikāya nāvāya vettabandhanabaddhāya vassamāsāni udake pariyādāya hem'antikena thalaṃ ukkhittāya vāt'ātapaparetāni vettabandhanāni.

36599.meaning1: made into a boat; constructed into a raft
